title: C03 package candidate
description: One immutable candidate package built from one commit of the integrated source: its tarball, and every member with the source path it was copied from or the fact that it was made at pack time. That per-member origin is the source-to-package mapping, so a member with no source and no pack-time origin cannot be listed. A cutover names the candidate it installs by this record's digest, and only one its owner registered. Registering it holds its closure over these members: a path a member `reaches` that no member provides is `runtime_path_missing` at the place naming that path, and a member copied from a path the integrated source declares author-side is `author_side_member` at its `copied_from`.

source_commit.description: The commit of the integrated source it was built from.

package_member.description: One file of the package: where it sits, its bytes, where they came from, and the paths it reaches when it runs.

reaches.description: The package paths this member's bytes name for the installed target to read when it runs — an installer's or an assembler's references — as the build found them. Each is another member's path. The owner reads the references again from the bytes it holds; one that is not a member is `runtime_path_missing`, at its place here, or at this list when the list leaves it out.
